verdict.rationale: Firecrawl is API-first: scrape, search, interact, crawl, map, batch, agent, parse and structured extraction are all exposed through the v2 API and SDKs, with a CLI, an MCP server and webhooks for async jobs. However, nothing shows that account and admin functions (key creation, IP allowlists, per-key restrictions, URL-blocking policies, audit streaming) can be configured via API rather than the dashboard, and no public OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, evidence that team/key/policy administration is API-accessible, published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
